title: Mario is the best!
text: Everyone should have a tour guide like Mario! He made us feel safe and taken care of. He was so knowledgeable about everything not just Montserrat but so many more cultural insights!
author: Caroline_S

title: Trust Ramon!
text:
Ramon was an exceptional tour guide. A former teacher with extensive knowledge and a great communicator.
A very safe driver,  too.
author: MARKTrampe

title: Thanks Alejandro for opening Montserrat for us
text: We had an excellent trip to Montserrat with Alejandro. He was right on time for pick up and began the tour with a friendly introduction, followed by a safe and informative drive to the monastery. He was very willing to share about Catalonia and its people and culture while we drove, which really added to our experience. At the site itself, he shared wonderful details about the history and construction and allowed for both group time as well as separate pursuits by us and the other family on the tour. We ere given a great chance to enjoy both the nature and the solemnity of Montserrat. Alejandr
author: W7334RTchrish

title: Monserrat Tour
text: Alejandro was an amazing guide. Very flexible and dedicated to what the tourists want to do. Very knowledgeable and happy to help with anything. Highly highly nightly recommend.
author: M9703CLjosieh

title: Amazing Montserrat
text: Alejandro was a fantastic guide for our family on a wet windy & cold day. He had extra jackets for our kiddos & was very knowledgeable about Montserrat monestary. He was generous with his time as we asked to see the the cross on the cliff & he took us even though it ran over the allotted time.
author: 976deanes

title: Tour de Monserrat
text: Alejandro is a wonderful and very personable guide. He was on time and made the experience very enjoyable despite the rainy weather. We took in the scenery at Montserrat (Catalonia, Spain) and rode the Funicular de Sant Joan and Santa Cova.  We were able to adjust our plans as needed. It was truly our personal tour. If you're in Barcelona and need a personal guided tour, request Alejandro with Viator.
author: 784rodicat

title: Breathtaking Spiritual Experience
text: What an amazing experience! First of all, our guide, Alex, was extremely knowledgeable and very attentive. He gave us an in-depth history of the monastery and the grounds. I was overwhelmed by its beauty and sense of spirituality experienced during the tour. Definitely ride the funicular or hike up to experience the monastery from above! It is very easy to spend an entire day on the grounds. One of the best experiences in Europe!
author: Carol_M
